title: Jev vs Open Decision Models: Laya, Cua-S1-Forms, and When Scoring Beats Sampling
description: Jev vs Laya vs Cua-S1-Forms: when scoring fixed options beats sampling text, and which open model to self-host.
lead: Verdict first: reach for Jev when you want a managed decision API today, self-host Laya when you need open weights and vendor-reported 33ms latency on your own hardware, and distill to CUA-S1-FORMS-shaped tiny specialists for single repetitive workflows like form-filling.
